narr: Heavy rain producing thunderstorms developed ahead of a cold front displacing warm and very humid air over Northeastern Pennsylvania. Torrential rainfall from consecutive rounds of thunderstorm activity produced areas of flash flooding and localized damage.
ev: Many streets flooded in the area.
